sources.snippet: Aether 2B is a compact PyTorch implementation of a 2B-parameter causal language model built around the architectural ideas in the DeepSeek-V4-Pro technical report. The goal is a single, self-contained reference codebase that is auditable from source PDF to running weights — no black-box dependencies, no vendored binaries.
